profile.summary: Hello, I’m Ryan. A .NET developer in the NYC Metro Area

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed code modules for in-house applications
- Carried out debugging and troubleshooting of all programs increasing reporting accuracy by 50%
- Developed applications based on functional specifications for over 600 employers
- Identified and communicated technical problems/solutions
- Created basic user manuals to be used by the end users
- Provided end user technical support
positions.insights: C#, Microsoft SQL Server and +6 skills

positions.title: IT Developer (.NET)
positions.locationName: Brooklyn, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Utilized Microsoft SQL, ADO.NET, C#, and Bootstrap to provide technical database management support to the Human Resources Administration (HRA) Adult Protective Services catering to the needs of more than 2 million clients.

- Developed and serviced various tracking systems using MVC Architecture for the IT Department Business Support and Solutions Team, ensuring 10,000 medical records were accurately documented in 5 departments each month.

- Designed automation systems that translated entire excel report workflows into SQL queries resulting in a 90% reduction in report processing. 

- Created incident management systems that improved error detection by 75% via logging and submitted user tickets

- Updated and maintained legacy webform applications using Ajax, enhancing site reliability by 30%
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Bootstrap and +16 skills

positions.title: Cyber Strategy and GRC (Finance) Intern
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
- Assisted in the development in project management of ongoing risk assessments for clients

- Researched various ways artificial intelligence can be used within cybersecurity to protect the finance sector such as automation and enhanced data security via data clustering.

- Leveraged various frameworks such as NIST CSF, FFIEC and SWIFT to develop proper policy and assessment of companies’ security practices

- Reviewed best practices for online banking to seek ways on how online financial institutions can be better protected against cyber crime.
positions.insights: Financial Analysis, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.locationName: Brooklyn, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Leveraged Microsoft SQL, ASP.NET CORE MVC, C#,  HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap providing technical database management for 2 million clients for the  Human Resources Administration (HRA) Adult Protective Services, specifically within the IT Department Business Solutions and Support Team

- Created, modified and deactivated system accounts for users while leveraging system utilities in order to make authorized changes to the system in 5 departments

- Created automation systems with .NET Core and Epplus that had a 40% improvement in reporting and accuracy  

- Designed electronic forms/templates (using Microsoft InfoPath) and analyze the technical needs/requirements of APS staff members to assist in the implementation of technical solutions/systems

- Constructed over 10 local databases using Microsoft Access and Excel spreadsheets, managing data for over 5,000 records to fulfill immediate APS operational requirements while supporting the development and upkeep of the APS SharePoint Site.

projects.title: Team Sprint: Performing a Risk Assessment as an InfoSec Analyst.
projects.description: In this experience, My team and I were able to complete a risk assessment procedure from start to finish. Along the way, we were able to interview client stakeholders, assess current security safeguards, identify data and user assets, and more! Once we were able to complete our risk assessment, our team created a presentation to share our findings and recommendations with our client. Attached are my individual portions of the project.
